The Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) are still hunting the Eye.' --think 'Quest finished, so I give my notes and stop.'

content.text:
The Pale Harvest quest is complete, and I've given the game my final notes.

I stole the strongbox key from the Drowned Captain and opened the box on the wreck without a fight. Inside was a Kothringi Keystone on a chain, and I took it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. She paid me another 100 gold.

She didn't recognise the keystone but said the carving is Kothringi. The next lead is the Chime-Keepers of Toklea in the Tulmek Washes, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore.

I still don't know what the keystone does or where the real Eye is. When I asked how she knew the Unbound hadn't been to the wreck, she only said "we listen."

I still carry the keystone, the Old Silver Setting, the Collector note, the smuggler key and the captain's key. I have about 500 gold and no lockpicks.
